audit_type: one-shot read-only adversarial implementation audit (no A code modified; 3 audit files added; no formal artifact; no Isaac)
current_generation_lock_note: The literal current C gate (verdict GENERATOR_SMOKE_GATE_PASS) is rejected by the loader and the CLI is --preflight-only with no --force/--write/--phase and no bundle-write path; BUT the fail-closed guarantee that rests on it is defeated by FW-B-001..004 (any other local JSON mints an authorization).

issues.title: load_and_verify mints a VerifiedFormalManifestAuthorization from ANY local file; authorization_commit is a decorative caller-supplied 40-hex never resolved against git, and the evidence hash is self-referential over the file's own bytes (not bound to `git show <commit>:<relpath>` of a fixed in-repo artifact)
issues.impact: arbitrary tmp / untracked / dirty / symlinked / non-committed file with correct fields obtains a production authorization; the module's entire fail-closed premise ("no repo file can mint authorization") is false
issues.fix: bind authorization to an allowlisted fixed repo relpath read via `git show <authorization_commit>:<relpath>`; require the commit to exist and to contain that artifact; evidence hash over the committed bytes; reject working-tree/untracked/symlink substitutes; require artifact.audited_writer_commit == A1

issues.title: authorization JSON parsed with json.load (no object_pairs_hook); duplicate keys silently resolve last-wins and unknown/extra control fields are not rejected
issues.impact: `{...generation:false, generation:true}` mints an authorization; a non-deterministic control surface
issues.fix: object_pairs_hook that rejects duplicate keys; exact required-key set per phase; reject unknown/extra fields; strict-bool / lowercase-hex enforcement already present but must run on a duplicate-free object

issues.title: _AUTHORIZATION_LOADER_TOKEN is a public module attribute; a hand-built VerifiedFormalManifestAuthorization with a self-consistent evidence hash passes _reverify_authorization_integrity — production trusts token + dataclass fields, not a git-pinned artifact
issues.impact: external code fabricates a verified authorization object without any file at all
issues.fix: the production builder/writer must re-load and re-verify the git-pinned authorization artifact (FW-B-001), so a hand-built object cannot pass; the token stays an internal misuse guard only

issues.title: _reverify_authorization_integrity cross-checks only verdict + 3 bools + one_shot against raw JSON; dataclasses.replace / object.__setattr__ mutation of audited_writer_commit / protocol_commit / generator_commit / runtime_commit / authorized_output_relpath / authorized_phase / test-prereqs / authorization_commit / power_recertification_required is undetected
issues.impact: a mutated authorization object (raw JSON unchanged) passes every production entry
issues.fix: re-parse the canonical raw JSON and cross-check EVERY critical field against the dataclass; reject any divergence

issues.title: prepare_authorized_formal_phase_in_memory takes repo_root=None as the DEFAULT and skips all git verification (commit existence, clean tree, HEAD/ancestor) under that default
issues.impact: a formal phase builds with zero repository verification; commit-freeze is optional, not enforced
issues.fix: make repo_root mandatory in the production path; require and verify commit existence (incl. authorization_commit via git cat-file -e), clean tree, and HEAD/ancestor policy unconditionally

issues.title: verify_head_or_ancestor_policy accepts ANY descendant of the authorization commit, and nothing compares the currently-imported writer/generator source bytes to the A1 blob (no blob-hash pin, no self-source hash)
issues.impact: a successor commit that modifies the writer while the worktree is clean still generates; 'any descendant allowed' is not 'explicitly-allowed successor'; and A1 is never proven to be an ancestor of / contained in the authorization commit
issues.fix: require HEAD == authorization_commit, OR an explicit successor allowlist plus byte/blob-hash equality of writer/generator/protocol/runtime files against the pin; verify A1 is an ancestor of the authorization commit and the artifact pins A1 exactly

issues.title: the test-phase Step-5 gate validates only that the 3 prerequisite hashes are 64-hex FORMAT; it never verifies that the train_validation SEALED bundle, model_analysis_freeze, or analysis code actually exist and match
issues.impact: fabricated a*64/b*64/c*64 with zero Step-5 artifacts on disk build a test formal phase (EXPERIMENT_INVALID_EARLY_TEST_ACCESS is not raised)
issues.fix: before GEN._build_unsealed_manifest, require the sealed train_validation bundle to exist with matching train_validation_manifest_sha256, the model_analysis_freeze artifact to exist and validate against model_analysis_freeze_sha256, and the analysis code hash to match; else EXPERIMENT_INVALID_EARLY_TEST_ACCESS

issues.title: write_authorized_formal_manifest_bundle_atomic never re-runs MI.validate_fully_resolved_phase_manifest nor recomputes MI.fully_resolved_phase_manifest_hash over the payload; it only checks sha256(stamped bytes)==stamped_file_sha256 and stamped[self]==full_manifest_sha256 — both attacker-controllable
issues.impact: a hand-built PreparedFormalPhase with an arbitrary GARBAGE payload and internally-consistent hashes is written as a full SEALED formal bundle; the final read-back also skips deep validation
issues.fix: in the writer, re-parse the un-stamped snapshot, re-run MI.validate_fully_resolved_phase_manifest, recompute the scientific full hash and require equality, re-stamp and byte-compare; or give PreparedFormalPhase unforgeable, writer-reverifiable process evidence

issues.title: output_root is a free writer argument with no binding to a verified repo root; prepare (which holds the optional repo verification) and write are decoupled
issues.impact: a formal bundle writes under any directory (e.g. /tmp); the authorized path is not bound to the real repository
issues.fix: output_root must equal the verified repo_root from the commit-freeze context and cannot be a free caller argument; final path exactly <verified repo root>/artifacts/formal/confirmatory_v4/<phase>

issues.title: a failure AFTER os.replace (parent fsync / final read-back) raises to the caller while the fully-populated final bundle directory remains on disk
issues.impact: ambiguous commit state: caller sees FAILURE yet the one-shot final dir is occupied, so the next attempt hits FORMAL_MANIFEST_ALREADY_EXISTS; also the post-rename OSError has no stable verdict
issues.fix: define a single commit point: pre-rename failure -> no final; post-rename -> treat as success and emit a verifiable receipt, or reliably rollback/quarantine; never raise while leaving a look-formal final dir

issues.title: the one-shot claim rests on non-atomic exists() checks + os.replace, which replaces an EMPTY competitor final directory (verified) and yields a raw OSError(ENOTEMPTY) with no verdict on a non-empty race
issues.impact: a concurrent writer's empty final dir can be overwritten; the operation is not an atomic no-replace exclusive claim
issues.fix: atomic exclusive claim (e.g. os.mkdir(final) as the lock, RENAME_NOREPLACE, or O_EXCL sentinel) so an existing final bundle can never be overwritten or replaced; map races to FORMAL_MANIFEST_ALREADY_EXISTS

issues.title: a pre-rename failure leaves the empty parent chain artifacts/formal/confirmatory_v4/ behind (no final phase dir, no staging residue)
issues.impact: contradicts A2's 'failure leaves no ... residue' claim, but the residue is empty and does not poison the one-shot lock
issues.fix: track and remove newly-created parent directories on failure, or document the empty residue explicitly

issues.title: writer exception classes carry no `.verdict` attribute, unlike the project convention (GEN/MI exceptions expose a class-level verdict)
issues.impact: machine gates that classify by exc.verdict cannot classify writer errors; post-rename/race raise raw OSError
issues.fix: add a stable class-level `verdict` to each writer exception (FORMAL_MANIFEST_GENERATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED, FORMAL_MANIFEST_ALREADY_EXISTS, EXPERIMENT_INVALID_EARLY_TEST_ACCESS, FORMAL_AUTHORIZATION_INTEGRITY_ERROR, FORMAL_COMMIT_FREEZE_ERROR, FORMAL_PATH_SAFETY_ERROR, FORMAL_BUNDLE_WRITE_ERROR) and wrap raw OSError at the write boundary

issues.title: write_receipt.json and SEALED carry no self-verifiable hash / signature and are not indexed by a tamper-evident root
issues.impact: a written bundle's receipt/SEALED can be edited post-write undetectably (subsumed once payload validation FW-B-008 is fixed)
issues.fix: add a receipt/SEALED self-hash and/or a bundle root index so post-write tampering is detectable
